title: Task-level accessibility audit report (report.json)
description: The only file the frontend reads. Backend changes are additive only: fields are never renamed or removed. Ignore unknown fields. null means 'not available', never 0.

url.description: Start URL of the audited task

mode.description: local = our own test sites; real = a third-party site (detection only, no fixes)

site.description: Source folder of the audited site, e.g. sites/shop/original (local mode only)

script.description: true = keys came from a pre-recorded script, false = the AI planner decided every key

goal.description: Task given to the planner, e.g. 'Buy the canvas tote bag'

judge.description: false = judge disabled; findings keep deterministic defaults and userImpact is empty

replayOf.description: Present when the report was rebuilt from an existing trace

startedAt.description: When the run started. Real mode: includes the time the human spent clearing captcha/login before pressing Enter. Absent in replays and in reports built before plan 17 P2

finishedAt.description: When the run's analysis finished (report written right after). finishedAt - startedAt = how long the audit took. Absent when startedAt is

maxSteps.description: Step limit of the planner (step 0 'start' not counted): 25 local, 80 real mode. Show 'used N / maxSteps steps'. Absent in replays and older reports

degrade.description: Findings that make the task harder but not impossible

filteredOut.description: Detector candidates the judge marked irrelevant (not shown)

axeViolations.description: axe-core WCAG rule violations on the same page states. null = axe could not run (show 'axe unavailable', never 0)

timeline.description: One entry per step, in order. Drives the step-by-step playback.

findings.description: Problems to show, block first then degrade. Findings judged irrelevant are already removed.

axe.description: axe-core baseline. null = not run; {error} = could not run; {violations} = ran

fixes.description: Per-finding result of `fix` (one entry per block finding). null until a fix has been run for this report; `fix` rewrites report.json with it.

applied.description: Number of edits applied to the patched copy; 0 = fix failed (see errors)

errors.description: Why edits of the last attempt were rejected (e.g. would remove visible text). Can be non-empty even when applied > 0.

rerun.description: Before/after comparison after fix + rerun on the patched copy. null until rerun.

runDir.description: Repo-relative run folder of the rerun, e.g. runs/2026-09-27T00-54-18-rerun (served at /runs/<id>/report.json)

key.description: Internal matching key; do not parse

introduced.description: Problems that appeared only after the fix (ids refer to the rerun's own report)

closedLoop.description: true = screen-reader user could NOT complete before the fix and CAN after it. The headline 'passes after fix'.

fixPolicy.description: What an automatic fix may change, as shown next to fixes. Present in every report built since plan 17 (older reports lack it). enforced = checked in code: an edit breaking one is rejected (the reason is in fixes[].errors); instructed = only asked of the fixer model, not checked.

stats.description: Run statistics. {} or null when no model was called (scripted runs).

ms.description: Total time of successful LLM calls (ms)

llmAttempts.description: All LLM attempts, including failed ones

rule.description: One sentence to show the user

rect.description: Box in CSS pixels of the viewport. Local mode (1280x800 at DPR 1) equals screenshot pixels. In general: multiply by timeline[].shotSize.dpr to get screenshot pixels, then scale by displayedWidth/shotSize.w.

agentCanComplete.description: Headline 2: can an AI agent that only uses structure (keyboard + screen-reader info) complete the task?

screenReaderUserCanComplete.description: Headline 1: can a screen-reader user complete it? = agent completed AND no blocking finding

unexplainedStuck.description: Agent got stuck but no detector explains why (needs a human look)

key.description: For press: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, Arrow*, Home, End

replace.description: type replaced the field content instead of appending

forcedReplace.description: Real-site safety forced replace (planner did not ask for it)

reason.description: The planner's one-line reasoning. Show it: this is 'what the AI is thinking'.

plannerError.description: The planner failed; this stuck step was produced by the runner

t.description: Milliseconds from step 0 to the moment this step was recorded (step 0 = 0), for a playback time axis such as 00:12. null = the trace has no timestamp for it. Absent in reports built before plan 17 P2

focus.description: What a screen reader says for the focused element, e.g. 'button "Pay"' or '(focus on page body)'

seen.description: LEFT/middle column: new text that appeared on screen after this step (noise removed)

seenNoise.description: Changes recognised as noise (carousels, countdowns). Optional to show, greyed out.

heard.description: RIGHT column: what assistive tech conveyed this step. Empty = the user heard NOTHING; show that prominently.

screenshot.description: Path relative to the report's folder, e.g. shots/0007.png. null = screenshot failed

shotSize.description: Actual pixel size of this step's screenshot and the page's devicePixelRatio. focusRect / seen[].rect are CSS pixels: × dpr = screenshot pixels. Local mode: {w:1280, h:800, dpr:1}; real mode depends on the human's window and display. null = no screenshot. Absent in reports built before plan 08.

findingIds.description: Findings whose evidence includes this step

id.description: F1, F2 ... unique within this report

detector.description: Known values: unannounced, association, trap, unnamed, weak-name, focus-lost, focus-visible, pointer-only. More will be added: render unknown values as-is.

layer.description: presence = info not exposed at all; association = not linked to the field; announcement = not announced when it changes; operation = cannot be operated by keyboard

steps.description: Timeline steps that are the evidence (jump targets)

impact.description: block = the task cannot continue; degrade = possible but harder

userImpact.description: One sentence on what the user experiences. Empty when the judge was off: hide it then.

judged.description: false = judge off or failed; impact is a deterministic default

axeAlsoFound.description: true = axe-core flagged the same element. Most of our findings are false here: that is the point.

barrierId.description: Planted-barrier id on our test sites; null on real sites

text.description: The on-screen text involved, e.g. 'Card number is invalid'

fix.description: null until `fix` ran, and null when no edit for this finding could be applied. Edits are search/replace on the site's source; only edits actually applied to the patched copy are listed.
